title: Unable to login to account
description: User receives 'Invalid credentials' error even after resetting password. Happens on both web and mobile app.

title: Payment failed but amount deducted
description: Customer paid for premium plan. Money was deducted from bank account but subscription is still showing as free plan.

title: Feature request: Dark mode
description: Would love to have a dark mode option in the dashboard for better night-time usage.

title: Export to CSV not working
description: When trying to export reports as CSV, the download button does nothing. Tested on Chrome and Firefox.

title: App crashes on Android 14
description: The mobile app crashes immediately after opening on devices running Android 14. Works fine on Android 13.

title: Incorrect invoice amount
description: Last month's invoice shows $149 but the actual plan is $99/month. Need corrected invoice and refund of difference.

title: Cannot invite team members
description: Invite emails are not being sent when adding new team members. No error message shown.

title: Slow loading dashboard
description: Dashboard takes more than 15 seconds to load. Performance has degraded significantly in the last week.

title: Two-factor authentication not sending codes
description: SMS verification codes for 2FA are not arriving. Email codes work fine.

title: Missing data in analytics report
description: Weekly analytics report is missing traffic data from September 1–3. Other metrics appear correct.

title: Request for API rate limit increase
description: Current rate limit of 100 requests/minute is insufficient for our production workload. Requesting increase to 500.

title: Password reset link expired immediately
description: Password reset emails contain links that show as already expired when clicked within 1 minute of receiving them.
